price_reference.note: September 9 close is used because the September 10 U.S. regular session had not opened at the Asia/Seoul checkpoint time. Actual shares are the July 30, 2026 filed share count; the 1.276B diluted valuation denominator is retained from the 2026-09-06 model for scenario comparability.

ttm_diagnostics.note: OCF-minus-capex-minus-SBC is a conservative diagnostic, not normalized owner FCF. FY2025 capex includes a combined PPE/intangible cash line while H1 comparative capex is PPE-only, and H1 OCF contains working-capital timing benefits including deferred revenue.

balance_sheet_and_commitment_diagnostic.note: Purchase commitments are contractual operating commitments, not funded debt, and are not mechanically subtracted from liquidity. They are monitored as demand-forecast and inventory-risk exposure.

reverse_expectations.method: Retain the 2026-09-06 Base model year-1 revenue of $13B, owner-margin path of 36% to 34%, 25x terminal owner-cash multiple, 1.276B diluted valuation denominator and 9% required return; solve a uniform revenue-growth rate for years 2-10 against the September 9 price.
reverse_expectations.interpretation: Approximately 16.82% annual growth after the model's $13B year 1 is a demanding long-duration requirement but not yet an obviously impossible bull-only case given the current 2026 growth guide. The main concern is the narrow expectation gap rather than near-term solvency.

bear.narrative: Major-customer spending normalizes, AI Ethernet share gains fail to materialize, gross margin compresses, supply commitments create inventory cost and mature owner margin falls.

base.narrative: Arista sustains high-teens/low-20s multi-year growth through AI, core data-center and campus expansion while normalized owner cash matures near the mid-30% range.

bull.narrative: Ethernet becomes the dominant AI fabric across scale-out and meaningful scale-up, Arista retains leading economics across 1.6T generations, customer concentration falls and owner margins stay exceptionally high.

two_state_price_position.note: This is an algebraic location of current price between two model endpoints, not an estimated probability.

management_outlook_overlay.one_point_six_timing: Trials in H2 2026; meaningful production expected in 2027 per management commentary.
management_outlook_overlay.treatment: Guidance is evidence of near-term demand and structural traction, not a guaranteed base-case fact. It does not eliminate customer-concentration, supply-commitment or duration risk.

valuation_conclusion: At $192.93, price remains approximately 16% above the retained Base intrinsic-value estimate and requires about 16.82% annual years-2-10 revenue growth under retained base economics. The price does not clearly require an unrealistic Bull case, but the margin of safety is insufficient. Fatal customer concentration and permanent-loss gates remain open, so buy authorization is false.
